title: swift-championship
label: "Gentlemen" Jonathan Marx

won.source: The promotion's own retrospective ("SWIFT- The Rise and Fall", 27 July 2011): Marx "defeated Landon Price in round three of the five round fight" at One Shot at Glory to become "the first and current SWIFT: MMA Champion." Dated by the show (13 February 2010; the announcement's title reads 6 February, and both readings are on the show's own record).

note: The retrospective states Marx "will be returning to SWIFT and will retain the title he earned" as of its own July 2011 date, so no loss is recorded.
